# Two parts. Hand entries go above the generated block and are never rewritten.
# The generated block is rewritten by .github/scripts/gen_branch_protect.py: every
# deletable-lane remote branch whose name occurs in ANY tracked file (json, csv,
# log and txt included) at the stamped revision. pr_hygiene.py refuses to delete
# when the stamp below is missing or older than 14 days, so regenerate before an
# apply run. CI never runs the repo-wide scan (the sweep checks out .github/ only).
# Branches cited after the stamped revision are NOT covered until the next
# regeneration. Cite commit SHAs, not branch names, in future evidence.
#
# This is a second layer. pr_hygiene.py also protects, without listing here:
# the default branch, perf-history, research/**, lit2026*, gh-readonly-queue/**,
# copilot/**, dependabot/**, release/**, any branch named in a workflow file,
# and any head or base of an open PR. Only codex/ claude/ cursor/ feat/ fix/
# branches can ever be deleted at all.
